quarantined_leads.lead: Alabama Republican lieutenant-governor candidate John Wahl faces a Montgomery County Circuit Court lawsuit alleging that he failed to satisfy the seven-year Alabama residency requirement and used conflicting names and residency records.
quarantined_leads.source_title: Lawsuit filed looking to remove Republican Lt. Gov. candidate John Wahl from ballot over residency
quarantined_leads.subject_response: John Wahl did not respond to WSFA's request for comment. Secretary of State Wes Allen said he could not comment on ongoing litigation in which he is a named defendant.
quarantined_leads.reason: WSFA reports a newly filed lawsuit and identifies Wahl as the Republican lieutenant-governor candidate; the Alabama Republican Party also documents his party leadership role. The underlying complaint was not independently obtained from the court in this pass, no direct response from Wahl was located, and the residency, identity, and eligibility claims remain unresolved allegations rather than established misconduct. A second local-TV version of the same report was reviewed, but it does not satisfy the stronger official-record or two-independent-reports-plus-response contract. Retain for follow-up and do not publish.

quarantined_leads.lead: Lauderhill Vice Mayor and District 4 Commissioner Richard Campbell was released on bond after arrest charges alleging domestic battery and witness tampering.
quarantined_leads.source_title: Lauderhill vice mayor arrested on battery, witness tampering charges; bonded out of jail, officials say
quarantined_leads.subject_response: Campbell's attorney denied the allegations, characterized the case as political persecution, and said Campbell would fight each allegation. Campbell previously said the alleged victim was his ex-girlfriend.
quarantined_leads.reason: CBS Miami and Local 10 independently report the arrest, bond, and defense response, but election records and the campaign context identify Campbell's municipal candidacy as nonpartisan. No explicit Republican, conservative, right-wing, or qualifying affiliated-organizational role was found. The allegations remain unresolved, so this continuation of the prior lead remains quarantined under the affiliation gate.
